title: Higher-Priced Mortgage Loan Flip Thresholds for Appraisal Orders
content:
The higher-priced mortgage loan property-flip thresholds below apply to every Appraisal Order report type in the Larkspur line.

| Report type | Short window (days since seller acquired) | Short-window price increase (percent) | Long window (days since seller acquired) | Long-window price increase (percent) | Borrower may be charged for the flip second appraisal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop) | 90 | 10.00 | 180 | 20.00 | No |
| Larkspur Exterior-Only Appraisal (Form 2055) | 90 | 10.00 | 180 | 20.00 | No |
| Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073) | 90 | 10.00 | 180 | 20.00 | No |
| Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) | 90 | 10.00 | 180 | 20.00 | No |
| Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA) | 90 | 10.00 | 180 | 20.00 | No |
| Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) | 90 | 10.00 | 180 | 20.00 | No |
| Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) | 90 | 10.00 | 180 | 20.00 | No |

- **Short window** — the days since the seller acquired the property within which the short-window price increase test applies: 90.
- **Short-window increase** — the price increase over the seller's acquisition price above which a second appraisal for a higher-priced mortgage loan is required in the short window: 10.00 percent.
- **Long window** — the days since the seller acquired the property within which the long-window price increase test applies: 180.
- **Long-window increase** — the price increase above which that second appraisal is required in the long window: 20.00 percent.
- **Charge** — whether the borrower may be charged for a higher-priced mortgage loan flip second appraisal: no, for every report type.
